brief.claim: Across subjects, mean resting heart rate and mean salivary cortisol (each subject's mean over the recording days) are positively correlated: the Pearson correlation between the two subject means is positive, and a test of that correlation gives two-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: resting heart rate in beats per minute of each subject on each recording day
morning salivary cortisol concentration of each subject on each recording day

brief.sizes: subjects = 16; days = 10 (heart_rate and cortisol: 16 x 10 = 160 values each)
